protocol.lightroom: presets IPR Nettete (protocole-nettete.md, 28 Oct campaign): Camera Neutral, radius 1.0, detail 25, masking 0, noise reduction 0, lens off, full frame, sRGB 16-bit; exported by the user 2026-11-15
protocol.ipr: iprRenderServer in memory, feature neutral (no lens), sharpening amount = Lightroom value, radius 1, masking 0
protocol.metrics: central half of the frame; edges = top 15 % of the 9 px local deviation of Lightroom's unsharpened L*; RMS of L* minus its 3x3 and 9x9 box mean on edges (d3, d9); halo = 0.5 and 99.5 percentiles of L* minus its 9x9 mean on edges; integer registration by correlation
protocol.model_fit: unsharp mask of the sRGB-encoded luminance fitted per Lightroom value on IPR's unsharpened render (scratch script sharpen_model.py); chosen: Gaussian 0.7 x radius, gain 1.9 (amount/50)^1.5, soft overshoot within 30 % of the 5x5 local range
protocol.grain_protection: kept at masking 0 by user decision (2026-11-15), unlike Lightroom
